exercises.question: A machine lifts a load of 100 N using an effort of 25 N. Find its mechanical advantage.
exercises.question_amharic: አንድ ማሽን 25 N ጉልበት በመጠቀም 100 N ክብደት አነሳ። ሜካኒካል አድቫንቴጁን ፈልጉ።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. Identify Load = 100 N, Effort = 25 N.\n2. Compute MA = 100 / 25.\n3. MA = 4.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic: 1. Identify Load = 100 N, Effort = 25 N.\n2. Compute MA = 100 / 25.\n3. MA = 4.
